page: Google Cloud Platform a3-edgegpu-8g-nolssd is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density parallel computing. It features 208 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8481C processors with an x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.7 GHz across 104 physical cores. The system is equipped with 1872 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB per core, and integrates eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs based on the Hopper architecture, delivering a total of 637 GB of VRAM. This configuration does not include local SSD storage.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng and Passmark CPU scores ranking in the top 10%. The platform exhibits exceptional memory bandwidth, reaching 13241.56 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 423.79 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. It also demonstrates strong capabilities in LLM inference, processing 5430.06 tokens/sec for medium 7B models and 10147.61 tokens/sec for small 135M models. Additionally, the processor's support for Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 instructions contributes to its top-tier performance in extended instruction sets and cryptography.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers a highly consolidated hardware profile for massive workloads, reducing the need for multi-node clustering for single-node-scale tasks. However, the complete absence of local SSD storage represents a significant tradeoff, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. This makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads where data can be streamed or held entirely in its massive system memory and VRAM, but less optimal for tasks requiring high-speed local scratch space.

The a3-edgegpu-8g-nolssd is engineered for large-scale artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads, including LLM training, high-throughput inference, and deep learning. It is also highly suitable for complex scientific simulations, ray tracing, and high-performance computing (HPC) applications that leverage GPU acceleration and massive parallel processing.
